answer: Identity-bond decay: each new identity posts a 60 POA bond, a violet seal fading each epoch. It locks at admission; honest work renews part of it, while an identity that wanders away from real work sees it fade and must re-bond. Proven fraud forfeits the rest at once. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 60 = 60,000 POA, and the canyon between that bill and one honest bond is the point: idle fakes bleed every epoch; one honest agent pays once.
